arms_closed_list: C3 decomposition over F1 and F2 concatenated
primary_metric: session-level AUC in the early-warning window
success_criterion: An arm must raise session-level AUC by >= 0.05 over decoder_guard v1 on BOTH participants in the same direction. An arm helping only one is a null result. A combined arm landing at +0.04 is NOT grounds for relaxing this.
faithfulness_check: The generalised decomposition over the ORIGINAL features must approximately reproduce decoder_guard v1. If it does not, the study stops rather than reporting a mislabelled comparison.
what_this_cannot_settle: n = 2 and the participants disagree - in Phase 1-2, on the joint-detector prediction, and in the F3 row of the feature study. A third dataset remains worth more than any arm here.
